text:
Elena: Quick idea — create a 'pocket scripts' set for SDRs & webinar hosts that focuses on three lanes: cost/efficiency, deployment flexibility, and ops/control. Lightweight lines, 1–2 sentences each. Thoughts?
Sam: Love it. Can we prioritize rebuttals vs 'cloud AI managed endpoints' and vs 'self-host infra vendors'? Those are different buyer pain points.
Elena: Exactly. For managed endpoints: lean into predictable unit economics + fallback routing + private deployment parity. Example short line: "Unlike single-tenant endpoints, Redwood lets you tune batching & quantization per-route so token cost drops without changing prompts." Keep it snappy for live reads.
Priya: Suggest A/B test two webinar CTAs: "See live benchmark: same model, 2–3x lower per-token cost" vs "See how we keep latency SLOs at scale". Track CTR by segment.
Jon: For inbound routing: map 'cost-minded' leads to cost script, 'security/compliance' leads to private-deploy thread. I can draft mapping rules for the CRM.
Marketing Bot: @channel new doc created: /docs/pocket-scripts-v1.md (stub) :sparkles:
Elena: Draft rebut snippets — dropping them here as a code block for pruning:
```
Managed Endpoint: "They're easy to spin up, but opaque pricing and no batching knobs — can cost you 2–3x at scale."
Infra Vendor: "You get kernels; you still need serve orchestration, rollouts, and fallbacks — Redwood ships those as a managed runtime."
Cloud AI: "We do cross-region fallback + model variants so customer apps keep serving during infra events."
```
Sam: These are solid. Make each line have at least one quantifiable claim where possible (percent or multiple).
Priya: For webinar slides, add one benchmark slide showing p50/p95 latency + per-token cost for a 4k context. Use the same open model for apples-to-apples. Call out the batching/kv-cache config used.
Elena: I'll assemble the battlecard + 10 pocket lines by EOD. Can someone draft 3 pithy hooks for the top of the slide share? Keep them <120 chars for social/Sales messages.
Jon: I'll handle inbound routing mapping in CRM and drop a brief snippet here:
```
cost -> SDR-costflow
security -> AE-enterprise
POC -> SolutionsEng
webinar-attendee -> Demo-request-queue
```
Sam: Thumbs up. When Elena posts the pack, tag #field-armory and the SDR leads. Also let analytics know to tag CTR by campaign_variant. :rocket:
Elena: Thanks — quick ask: keep each SDR script <=120 chars and no more than 2 rebut bullets. I'll iterate once Jon's CRM mapping lands.
Priya: One more: for benchmarking narrative, add a short slide called "What we tuned" that lists batching, quantization profile, and routing policy so we don't get called out on apples-to-oranges.
Elena: Good call. I'll include that. Meeting sync in 30 if anyone wants to review the first draft live.
Jon: I'll be there.
Sam: Same.
Marketing Bot: Reminder scheduled: 30m meeting — #marketing-calendar entry created.
